name: iCTRL
subtitle: AI 手机自动化引擎
description: OpenMinis iCTRL 的 AltStore / SideStore 源。自动跟随 GitHub Releases 更新。

apps.name: iCTRL Runner
apps.subtitle: 自动化执行引擎（必装）
apps.localizedDescription:
XCUITest 自动化引擎。常驻后台，在 8200 端口提供 JSON-RPC 2.0 服务，让 AI 代理可以点击、滑动、输入、读取任意 App 的界面。

装好后从桌面点一下图标启动；它没有前台界面，会闪一下进入后台，随后在通知栏显示「iCTRL Server Ready」。

前提：开发者磁盘镜像（DDI）已挂载。重启手机后需要重新挂载。

versions.localizedDescription:
An AI-friendly iOS/iPadOS automation service. Tell your agent *"My iPhone is running iCTRL at :8200 — figure out how to drive it."* and it reads the on-device manual and takes it from there. Works with any agent that can make HTTP requests: OpenClaw, Hermes, Minis, Claude Code, Codex and others. ## Downloads ### Which IPA do I need? | File | Needed? | What it is | |---|---|---| | `iCTRLUITests-Runner.ipa` | **Required** | The automation engine. It serves the JSON-RPC API that agents and clients call, and must be running. | | `iCTRL.ipa` | Optional | A companion app for tasks on the phone itself:
• mount the Developer Disk Image without a Mac, and remount it after a reboot
• start and stop the runner
• choose who can reach the runner (this device only / LAN / LAN + nearby)
• see and revoke authorized clients
• read the runner's log live | Skip `iCTRL.ipa` if you mount the Developer Disk Image with Xcode or StikDebug, and manage the runner from its notification or a computer. With a free Apple ID you get three sideloaded apps, and SideStore uses one of them. Install StikDebug *or* the iCTRL app alongside the runner, not both. Both IPAs are unsigned for distribution (ad-hoc, no provisioning profile). Sign them when you install: - **Free Apple ID:** the latest SideStore signs and installs them. Older SideStore releases skip the nested `.xctest`, and the runner then crashes on launch. - **Paid account:** `Scripts/sign-ipa.sh -i iCTRLUITests-Runner.ipa` The runner also needs the Developer Disk Image mounted (Xcode, StikDebug or the iCTRL app). The [README](https://github.com/OpenMinis/iCTRL#installation) covers the whole setup. ## What's new since 1.98.15 ### Input - **Continuous single-finger drag paths.** `drag` accepts a `points` array (2-64 waypoints, 0.1-10 s) and follows it with one finger, pressing once and lifting once. Draw corners, unlock patterns, drag-to-reorder. Corners can be rounded by 1-2 pt, so keep each segment at least one frame long. Advertised as the `drag_path` capability. Existing endpoint/ref drags are unchanged. Thanks to @YanYunNN. ### Build - `make ipa UNSIGNED=1` builds release IPAs without a signing identity. ## Earlier in 1.98.13 - 1.98.15 - The video stream skips identical frames while the screen is still, and no longer goes black after the runner was in the background. - The remote page keeps FPS, quality and verbose across reloads. - `type` falls back to on-screen key taps when a field drops focus and reports failures. `keyboard.visible` detects third-party keyboards. - More methods require authorization. The iCTRL app imports RemotePairing files such as StikDebug's pairingFile.plist.

apps.name: iCTRL
apps.subtitle: 伴侣管理 App（可选）
apps.localizedDescription:
伴侣 App，负责周边事务：

• 免电脑挂载开发者磁盘镜像（DDI），重启后一键重挂
• 启动 / 停止 Runner，查看运行状态
• 管理已授权客户端，查看来源并吊销
• 实时查看 Runner 日志
• 切换可见性：仅本机 / 局域网 / 附近发现

如果已经用 Xcode 或 StikDebug 挂载 DDI，可以不装这个。
